create_EQACNNPretrainDataset: create an EQACNNPretrainDataset instance from a Habitat config for train or val mode
save_frames_to_lmdb: save rgb, depth, and semantic segmentation frames from shortest path positions to an LMDB database
load_scene_in_simulator: load a new scene into the Habitat simulator by reconfiguring the simulator with the scene path
getitem_rgb_depth_seg: retrieve an indexed batch of rgb, depth, and segmentation tensors from the LMDB cache for training
check_cache_exists: check whether the EQA-CNN pretrain dataset LMDB cache directory exists and contains data
